label: APRS Stations → TAK
info:
Live APRS stations in Tennessee (plus a small buffer): mobiles, digipeaters, iGates, objects and weather stations (wind and temperature in the remarks, in °F). Stations show as friendly.

Data: APRS-IS (aprs2.net) (https://www.aprs2.net/). Updates every live (as stations beacon).

Needs: [node-red-contrib-tcp-client](https://flows.nodered.org/node/node-red-contrib-tcp-client) (Manage palette > Install).

Setup:
1. Double-click TAK Server :8089, set your TAK Server address, then edit its TLS config and upload your client certificate and key.
2. Set APRS_CALLSIGN in the tab's Environment Variables to your callsign. The flow logs in receive-only (passcode -1), so no passcode is needed.
3. Click Deploy.

Full instructions: https://github.com/SECT0101/NodeRED-TAK/tree/main/flows/aprs
